conduit.about: RealWorld (Conduit) API on ASP.NET Core 10 with EF Core and SQLite. Known-solution set: the upstream code and the upstream API tests are the check.

dashboard.about: Practical.CleanArchitecture Monolith: admin dashboard for users, roles, products, files, settings and audit logs on .NET 10 and Angular 22. Main set.
test: dotnet test src/Monolith/ClassifiedAds.UnitTests -v q -nologo && dotnet test src/Monolith/ClassifiedAds.ArchTests -v q -nologo
dashboard.notes: The headless patch adds PostgreSQL in a container, a test sign-in (header X-Test-User: admin or user), enforced permission claims, and eval/start.sh and eval/stop.sh. Two upstream test projects (Migrator.Tests, ContractTests) fail on the pinned commit without the patch, so they are not run.
